2018150.content: Note the trick: empty is initialised to 0 and full to N here, i.e. the names are swapped vs textbook. Producer must wait on a free slot = full (N), then signal empty. Consumer waits on empty, signals full. So P=full, Q=empty, R=empty, S=full -> option C. Doubt: would it deadlock if mutex was acquired before wait(P)?

Quick way to remember: the semaphore you wait on is the resource you consume. Producer consumes free slots (full, init N here because names are swapped) and produces filled slots (empty). Consumer is the mirror. So P=full, Q=empty, R=empty, S=full. The trick in this question is only that the names are swapped vs the textbook.
